entries.e86c3abbf231ce1a: This is a business model built on interface technology centered on surfactants: it manufactures chemical materials such as low-dielectric resin materials, battery materials, sucrose fatty acid esters and various surfactants, and sells them to manufacturers in Japan and overseas to earn revenue.
entries.ea6e2e6d4408df95: Based on the company motto handed down since its founding, 'Quality First, Cost Reduction, Research Effort,' as its management guideline, it aims to realize its corporate principle, 'Contribute to the nation and society through industry.' From April 2025, it launched the five-year medium-term management plan 'SMART 2030,' with basic policies of strengthening the business operation structure through the introduction of a business division system, strengthening the R&D structure centered on the Production Technology Research Institute and the Kyoto Central Research Laboratory, and reforming the personnel system and promoting talent development. As field-specific policies, it aims to expand sales of low-dielectric materials compatible with next-generation high-speed communications and enter next-generation semiconductor materials in Electronics & Information; develop lithium-ion battery-related materials in Environment & Energy; expand sales of the food with function claims 'Tōchūkasō' in Life & Wellness; and extend interface technology into focus areas in Core Materials.
